laws.rule: The Osun government directive published on 15 October 2026 schedules compulsory environmental sanitation every Thursday from 08:00 to 10:00 across the state. It expects offices, market operators, shops, artisans, malls, stores and business premises to be physically present for the exercise. It instructs enforcement agents to enforce compliance but not arrest anyone. The notice does not announce a general ban on visitor movement.

local-law.note: Executive sanitation directive only. No tourist travel restriction or penalty is inferred. Other state laws and municipal levels are not yet checked.

sources.title: Osun declares Thursday environmental sanitation day, 15 October 2026
sources.authority: Osun State Government, Head of Service and Environmental Sanitation Taskforce
sources.supports: Read directly: immediate statewide Thursday 08:00 to 10:00 sanitation directive; listed offices and business premises are expected to participate; enforcement agents instructed not to arrest anyone.

closures: Weekly Thursday sanitation exercise, 08:00 to 10:00, announced with immediate effect on 15 October 2026. Listed offices, markets and business premises are expected to participate; service availability may be affected. This is not a public holiday and the notice does not declare a general movement ban.
culture-cycles.note: Only this weekly sanitation cycle checked. Public holidays and other community closures not yet checked.
